title: The Five Dispositive and the Rest

blocks.s: The first five grades are preparatory and dispositive to contemplation. The last five pertain substantively to contemplation, if by the last one is meant the vision of God in his essence, which is consummated contemplation. The sixth and seventh grades participate somewhat of both. For sincere prayer and interior consolation are not without contemplation, since prayer is the ascent of the mind to God, and consolation flows from the consideration of what is fitting.
